tests.d66_offline: not qualifying: existing offline launcher test reached expected runtime-unavailable startup/native-seed refusals and did not establish D124 helper adoption

findings.fact: arrival is begun from RuntimeHandler._dispatch trace entry, after the HTTP server has already accepted the connection and, for timeline commits, after body prefetch in _dispatch.
findings.impact: This is dispatch observation relabeled as arrival; it cannot prove network arrival and violates the required unsupported-network/null boundary rule. request_wall_ms and its sampler denominator inherit this false boundary.

findings.fact: D66 configures the helper as path.join(RUNTIME_CHECKOUT, 'tests/helpers/p2_commit_phase_capture.py') and serviceRecipe supplies only ASTRID_RUNTIME_CHECKOUT; it has no explicit reviewed diagnostic helper path/hash route.
findings.impact: The candidate helper cannot be attached through the supported normal D66 route while production Runtime remains immutable at 5e9ad. The candidate's offline test manually imports sitecustomize and directly calls _start_capture, so it does not prove the normal D66 attachment recipe.

findings.fact: observer_cpu_ms is one capture-wide sampler CPU counter copied into every request summary, with no capture-wide overhead scope.
findings.impact: Concurrent or multi-request summaries can attribute the same sampler overhead repeatedly; the exported overhead scope is not truthful per-request accounting.

qualification.normal_full_body: blocked until D66 accepts and records the reviewed helper path/hash without changing production Runtime source/manifest
